component.name: Illust Viewer
component.summary: Browse and organize illustrations with tags

description.p: Illust Viewer shows the illustrations of a local folder as a gallery, and lets you give them a title, tags, source URLs, and a note. The metadata is stored next to each image in a sidecar JSON file, so it stays with the image when the folder is synced or moved.

ul.li: Search by title, note, and tag
Browse tags by namespace, such as creator or series
Add images by drag and drop or from the clipboard
